text: In flux balance analysis, the feasible flux space defined by S·v = 0 together with the bounds v_min ≤ v ≤ v_max forms a convex polytope.
explanation: This is true: the steady-state equality constraints combined with the linear upper and lower flux bounds define a convex polytope in flux space, which is exactly why flux balance analysis can be solved efficiently as a linear program. Convexity guarantees that any local optimum found is also the global optimum.
